headline: Saginaw Valley State finish top of the table
dek: Saginaw Valley State's one defeat on the record came at home to Northern Michigan in September, and they did not lose again. On the last day Roosevelt won at Purdue Northwest, ending a run of wins the home side had carried since losing at Saginaw Valley State.
displaced_by: The standing lines stopped being true: Roosevelt won at Purdue Northwest on the final day and ended Purdue Northwest's run. Every side has now played its full conference schedule, so the table is complete with Saginaw Valley State top.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring is top-heavy: Northern Michigan alone have scored more than Davenport and St. Cloud State together.

wire.line: Saginaw Valley State take the table beaten only once, and that at home by Northern Michigan.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches whose dates have passed carry no published result, the earliest of them Northern Michigan's opening match against Green Bay.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Luca Rosen has scored sixteen goals from 76 shots for Northern Michigan.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Matty Telfer has scored thirteen of Saginaw Valley State's 34 goals, from 55 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Sergio Cano Castro, a freshman, has ten assists for Northern Michigan.

last_match.line: Roosevelt end Purdue Northwest's winning run and have now won on both grounds this season.
